class.name: UltralightAPI
class.brief_description: Persistent application API registry with a caller-selected JavaScript namespace.
class.description: Create with create(namespace), register functions or objects, then attach to one or more UltralightView nodes. Namespaces are single ASCII JavaScript identifiers and must not collide with existing page globals. Registrations are installed before window_ready and page scripts on every new document. Shared containers are the default. Unregistering, detaching or closing also revokes cached JavaScript references. The reserved namespace member $bridge provides copy(value) and get/set(dictionary, key, ...). All bridge access must occur on the Godot main thread.

method.name: create
method.description: Create a registry for one ASCII JavaScript identifier. Invalid or reserved identifiers return null. Does not export a global until attached.

method.name: is_closed
method.description: Return whether this registry has been closed.

method.name: register_function
method.description: Register or replace a synchronous callable. Shared conversion is the default for arguments and results. Return a Result for installation success.

method.name: register_async
method.description: Register a handler receiving (UltralightTask request, Array arguments). Resolve or reject the request on the main thread; JavaScript receives a Promise.

method.name: register_object
method.description: Register or replace a Godot object, Array or Dictionary. Apply optional member, read-only and copy settings. Nil is rejected.

method.name: unregister
method.description: Remove this registration from all attached views and revoke its old proxies.

method.name: attach
method.description: Attach to an UltralightView, immediately if a document exists and automatically on later documents. Idempotent; return an error for namespace conflicts.

method.name: detach
method.description: Remove this registry from the given View and revoke its namespace without closing the View. Idempotent.

method.name: close
method.description: Detach all views, revoke proxies and clear definitions. Idempotent.
